obligations.statement: A frozen install either materializes exactly the lockfile graph or fails before mutating the install tree.
assumptions: filesystem commit/rename operations are atomic at the modeled boundary

obligations.statement: One content digest cannot name two distinct byte sequences in the immutable package store.
assumptions: the selected digest is collision resistant

obligations.statement: Publishing is admitted only for a clean tree whose required version tag points at the exact source commit.
assumptions: the VCS host reports authenticated tag and commit identities

obligations.statement: Every documented command alias normalizes to the canonical subcommand before flags, environment, and behavior are resolved.
assumptions: shell tokenization occurs before CLI parsing

obligations.statement: Identical source, manifest, lockfile, platform, and pinned toolchain inputs produce byte-identical package artifacts.
assumptions: timestamps, ordering, ownership, and compression parameters are normalized
